source: Independent source-informed geometry and subscription-lifecycle implementation. Public declarations and selected original tests retain MIT attribution; no upstream runtime is included. This is not a clean-room claim.

implementation.targetScope: DOM positioning platform, middleware reexports and autoUpdate, focused on the popover, tooltip and dropdown callers.

changes: Each autoUpdate subscription owns its listener even when callers share the same callback.
Cleanup is idempotent, cancels pending frames/timers and suppresses queued observer notifications; setup exceptions roll back resources.
Direct platform clipping calls do not require private cache setup, and inherited custom platform methods remain usable.
Geometry shares offset-parent coordinate handling, uses a Set for ancestor filtering and delegates middleware to VPM core.

verification.browser: 144 app middleware scenarios, 319 platform/viewport geometry cases and six unchanged upstream tests in Chrome. Includes scale, RTL, scrolling, fixed positioning, tables, SVG, shadow DOM, virtual references, iframes and top layers.
verification.runtime: Seven Node 24/Bun groups include original/VPM lifecycle fault controls, ordinary geometry, module identity and custom platforms.
verification.limits: Chrome verification is not certification of Safari/Firefox, every React interaction or browser frame rate. Controlled DOM benchmarks measure JavaScript work, not layout or rendering.
